item.title: Nagara River Valley: One of Japan's Clearest Rivers — Guide
item.description: The Nagara River is counted among Japan’s three clearest rivers, flowing from the mountains of central Gifu through scenic gorges and green valleys on a largely undammed course that has kept its water exceptionally pure. This clarity supports the river’s famous ayu sweetfish and the centuries-old tradition of ukai cormorant fishing near Gifu City, while upstream the valley offers scenic drives, riverside walks and rafting, and the water itself is central to the culture and cuisine of the towns along its banks.
